title: Question de suivi générée par IA
difficulty_why: Written defence of the previous query: explain AND vs OR as intersection vs union with a concrete counter-example.
rubric: States that AND keeps only rows meeting both conditions (intersection of the two sets).
States that OR keeps a row as soon as one condition holds (union of the two sets).
Says the OR result always contains the AND result, plus extra rows, so it would not match the requirement.
Gives a concrete row that passes with OR but not with AND (e.g. 9 years with 0.79, or 4 years with 0.99).
Links the choice back to the wording of the goal ('at least 5 years and at least 0.8').
